children.topic: Standard Parameter / Finding: Total Serum Bilirubin >3 mg%
Clinical Significance: Confirms overt clinical jaundice. (Sub-clinical is 1-3 mg%).
Standard Parameter / Finding: Elevated Direct Bilirubin, Elevated Alkaline Phosphatase (AP), GGT
Clinical Significance: Confirms post-hepatic (biliary obstruction) pathology. Concomitant GGT rise is highly liver-specific.
Standard Parameter / Finding: Vitamin K Test (IV Vitamin K administration for a few days)
Clinical Significance: If PT/INR improves: Obstructive Jaundice. If PT/INR fails to improve: Hepatocellular damage.
Standard Parameter / Finding: SGOT, SGPT, Serum Albumin, Child-Pugh Score
Clinical Significance: Determines hepatic synthetic reserve and operative eligibility.
Clinical Significance: Safely demonstrates intrahepatic biliary duct dilation, CBD dilation, and stones/masses.
Standard Parameter / Finding: ERCP (with Sphincterotomy & Dormia basket)
Clinical Significance: Highly effective for CBD stone extraction. (PTC reserved if obstruction is high up at the porta hepatis).
